title: Shapes in the Workshop

readiness.math: sorting by shape: squares, triangles, circles (older: and rectangles)
readiness.reading: pre-reader friendly; all text can be read aloud

intro.speaker: amos
intro.text: Hello there! I'm Mr. Amos. I make things from wood: tables, doors, toys, anything.

intro.speaker: amos
intro.text: Look at my offcut box, all muddled up! Can you help me sort the wooden shapes into their boxes?

steps.speaker: amos
steps.prompt: Put each shape in the box with the same shape on it.
steps.hint: Count the corners. A triangle has three, a square has four, and a circle has none.

older.prompt: Sort the shapes. Careful: a square has four sides all the same, but a rectangle has two long sides and two short.

feedback.mismatch: Count its corners and look at its sides. Which box is it like?
feedback.all_good: Every shape is in its own box. Now I can find what I need!

outro.speaker: amos
outro.text: A tidy workshop is a happy workshop. Come back tomorrow: I've a job that needs a careful eye.

journal_line: I met Mr. Amos the carpenter and sorted the wooden shapes in his workshop.
unavailable_text: The shapes are sorted for today.
